model.title: A bill to prohibit the transfer of certain offices and functions of the Department of Education to other Federal agencies, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Timothy Kaine (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would prevent the Department of Education from transferring certain offices and functions to other federal agencies without explicit Congressional approval. It aims to protect specific Education Department operations from being moved or consolidated into other parts of the government.
